_batch.cross_item_tell: No strong rule. Key ranks over 32: smallest 9, 2nd 7, 3rd 7, largest 9 (extreme 18/32 = 56.3% vs 50% chance). Best ask-type rule: 'on a least ask pick an end' hits 4/5 (D5, D6, B6, A8; miss C8); 'on a sum ask pick an end' 4/6 (B3, C3, A4, D2; miss B4, A3); count asks ends 4/8, greatest 2/5, difference 3/5. Recurring distractor recipes: (a) 'positive-k branch only' sub-answer below the key in C5 (6), B2 (13), C2 (2), C3 (162) - in all four the key is larger than the branch-only option, and in C5/C3 the key is the largest option; (b) the rounded LP corner sits just past the key in the infeasible direction in D4 (75 vs 71) and D5 (55 vs 58), so 'take the option one step beyond the rounded-corner value' works on those two. Also: key is the opposite end from the ask direction in D5 and A8 (least -> largest) and C7 (greatest -> smallest).
